failure_modes: A temporal_teacher blend (C009-C011) applied on unvalidated non-monotone contrast could displace surrounding coordinates without affinity benefit, since the observed-node fits are descriptive and not extrapolable.
Selecting a temporal_region (C008) or region_index (C004) without validated regional evidence could shift attention to a region with no demonstrated affinity advantage.

Changing pointcloud_delta_A (C001-C003) or teacher_neighbors (C005-C007) away from the incumbent values lacks supporting evidence and could alter the reward scale or teacher set without expected affinity gain.
Treating the observed-node temporal derivative or contrast sign changes as a spatial coordinate gradient would be an incorrect interpretation and could motivate an unjustified coordinate push.
result.rationale: D1.2: The incumbent is a stationary coordinate target (program D2_without_trajectory_static, reward_view endpoint_pointcloud, time_ramp_power 0.0, teacher_score_beta 0). The permitted time-conditioned alternatives are the registered temporal recipes: temporal_region (C008) changes regional attention at observed score nodes using the same static teachers, and temporal_teacher (C009-C011) blends the static endpoint reward with an observed-teacher reward. Analyst's temporal evidence (continuous:0-5) shows non-monotone observed-node contrast with four to ten sign changes and large opposing first/last rate z-values, but polynomial_accepted false, extrapolation_allowed false, and relative node RMSE 0.29-0.78. These are descriptive contrast diagnostics over the observed window, not validated fits, so no registered temporal recipe is confirmed to express the observed contrast (H001 falsifier partially met) and a single signed whole-window contrast is unsupported (H002). The evidence therefore does not establish that any time-conditioned alternative changes teacher coordinates or regional attention in a defensible way; the only clearly bounded change would be a dose-like blend, which is not supported either. D4.1: Compared with the incumbent, no offered choice provides a defensible expected advantage: C001-C003 alter pointcloud_delta_A away from the incumbent 1.0 A without evidence tying delta to affinity gain; C004/C008 select regions without validated regional evidence; C005-C007 change teacher_neighbors from the incumbent 4 without evidence; C009-C011 introduce a temporal blend whose contrast is not validated. Retaining the incumbent is the evidence-supported decision. D4.2: The predicted failure of a temporal blend is unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates: an unvalidated time-conditioned contrast would push coordinates along a non-monotone direction that reverses within the window, moving neighbors without a validated affinity benefit, and since the objective is affinity-first with coordinate control only, such displacement is not justified. This prediction reinforces retaining the incumbent. No temperature edit is proposed; temperatures remain fixed task parameters.
